en.headline: Man arrested over alleged indecent exposure to five schoolgirls in Yau Tong
en.dek: Police detained a 26-year-old man after two incidents involving secondary school students near a playground and estate in the district.
body: Police have arrested a 26-year-old local man, surnamed Lui, on suspicion of indecent exposure in two incidents involving five secondary school girls in Yau Tong.

The girls, aged 14 to 16 and members of their school's volleyball team, reported the first incident at about 6.30pm on 21 September near the men's public toilet at Lei Yue Mun Road Playground. The man allegedly lowered his shorts, exposed his buttocks while covering his genitals, and stood with his back to them.

A second incident occurred at about 7pm on 15 October outside Yan Lai House at Yau Lai Estate, where the man allegedly repeated the act. The students told their volleyball coach, who helped them report the cases to police.

Officers from the Kwun Tong District Crime Squad reviewed CCTV footage and arrested the man at Yau Lai Estate on Tuesday. He was taken to his home, where clothing matching the descriptions was seized. He remains in custody for investigation.
Under the Crimes Ordinance, the offence of indecent exposure in a public place carries a maximum penalty of a HK$1,000 fine and six months' imprisonment.

zh.headline: 油塘第三隊十六歲男涉向五名女學生露體被捕
zh.dek: 警方拘捕一名26歲男子，涉兩度在鯉魚門道遊樂場及油麗邨附近向中學女學生暴露臀部。
body: 警方以涉嫌猥褫暴露身體拘捕一名26歲本地男子（姓呂），事件涉及五名油塘中學女學生。
受害人為14至16歲的中三及中四女學生，同為校內排球隊成員。第一宗個案發生於9月21日傍晚約6時半，在鯉魚門道遊樂場男公廁外，該名男子涉嫌除下短褲，背向女學生暴露臀部，同時遮掩私處。
第二宗發生於10月15日傍晚約7時，在油麗邨仁麗樓外，該男子涉嫌重施故技。女學生向排球教練通報後報案。
觀塘警區刑事調查隊翻查閉路電視後，於周二在油麗邨拘捕該名男子，並到其住所檢獲相信是發案時所穿的衣物。他現正被扣留調查。
根據《刑事罪行條例》，在公眾地方猥褫暴露身體可被判罰款1,000元及監禁6個月。
